description: This file contains utility functions and classes for working with torch.fx graphs, including node target resolution, fusion group detection, graph legalization, and stable topological sorting, specifically tailored for internal use within the torch.fx framework.

classes.name: FxNetAccFusionsFinder
classes.description: Finds groups of connected ACC nodes that pass non-tensor data between each other, forming fusion groups.

methods.name: get_acc_ops_name
methods.description: Returns a string name for an accumulator operation, based on its module or name.

methods.name: get_node_target
methods.description: Returns the target typename of a given fx node, considering its operation type.

methods.name: is_node_output_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a node's output produces a torch.Tensor, based on shape metadata.

methods.name: legalize_graph
methods.description: Reorders a torch.fx GraphModule's nodes into a topologically sorted order, not preserving original order.

methods.name: stable_topological_sort
methods.description: Reorders a torch.fx GraphModule's nodes into a topologically sorted order while preserving original node order as much as possible.
